sections.title: Executive summary
sections.body: 5 reviewed finding(s) bear on: map the publicly documented exposure of example.com and rank the advisory-backed risks. None of them is corroborated by a second independent origin, so every finding below carries the band it earned. 1 explanation(s) remain open; this document does not claim that it has excluded the others. Confidence: low.

sections.title: Scope and methods
sections.body:
Objective: map the publicly documented exposure of example.com and rank the advisory-backed risks
The question this mission set out to answer: the published advisories name the affected component
Sources reviewed: published-advisories (3 item(s)); dns-and-archive (3 item(s))
Methods: every Worker result was judged on seven quality dimensions (§34) before it could be forwarded, retried attempts were re-tasked with a specific correction (§35), each Subagent reconciled duplicates and preserved disagreements (§36), the Master reviewed the report set with five lenses and a bounded loop (§37, §38), and this synthesis cites only evidence that survived all four.
Evidence base: 5 reviewed item(s) from 5 independent origin(s).

sections.title: Key findings
sections.body: Each finding below is a reviewed evidence item, restated without embellishment. Confidence is derived from the number of independent origins behind it and capped by its epistemic kind.

sections.title: Corroborated indicators
sections.body: No claim was corroborated by a second independent origin, so the mission reports none. Every finding above is single-source and says so.

sections.title: Competing hypotheses
sections.body: 1 explanation(s) were tested; 1 remain possible. A hypothesis the mission could not test is listed as untested rather than omitted.
item_ids: the published advisories name the affected compo

sections.title: Contradictions
sections.body: No two reviewed items make the same claim with opposite polarity, so the mission records no contradiction. Silence here is a finding: nothing the mission collected conflicts with anything else it collected.

sections.title: Confidence levels
sections.body:
Mission confidence: low.
Basis: the weakest of 5 finding(s) sets the level: single-source (1 origin(s)), because the answer cannot be stronger than the claim it depends on
Bands: single-source 5, corroborated 0, well-corroborated 0
Band rules: one independent origin is single-source; two are corroborated; three or more are well-corroborated. An allegation is capped at corroborated — a third party repeating a claim does not establish it — and an inference is capped at corroborated, because reasoning over good evidence is still reasoning.

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.body: The mission closed every gap it opened. That is a claim about the questions it asked, not about the target: questions it did not think to ask are not in this list.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.body: — the deterministic runner does not contact the target

sections.title: Recommended next steps
sections.body: 1 step(s), each naming what it settles and why it is lawful. None requires touching a system or contacting a person.
